# Test photo

`leather-bag.jpg` (960 × 640) is "Handbag Leather" by Harsh Jadav, from StockSnap:
https://stocksnap.io/photo/handbag-leather-Z9ESJO45V5

License: CC0 1.0 (public domain dedication), https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/
No attribution is required; it is credited here anyway.

`tests/browser-test.js` uploads it (scaled up to 2400 px, so the page has to shrink it) and uses it for the
README screenshots. The sample listing in `tests/mock-anthropic.php` describes this bag.
